怪奇「物」語 #5
programme.desc: 我們在本集會看一些世上最大的昆蟲蟬形齒指蝦蛄被獵食者威嚇時,會打開翅膀,展露代表警告的色彩和圖案巨型非洲百足是溫和的草食性動物,但不代表能欺負牠

programme.title: 「非」一般海岸 #2
programme.desc: 在非洲的東海岸,溫暖的厄加勒斯角以獨特的亞熱帶景觀向南延伸從紅樹林沼澤到色彩斑斕的珊瑚礁所構成的區域,當中有在長而暖的沙灘上繁殖的海龜,以及最近才發現的「活化石」- 腔棘魚,牠棲息在深海底的峽谷中

programme.title: 動物超感官 第一季 #1 英普
programme.desc: 視野對生存尤關重要這是百分之九十五的動物瞭解世界的方法眼睛是如此重要,從難以置信地簡單到令人費解地複雜,它們已經獨立地進化了近百次

programme.title: 動物超感官 第一季 #2 英普
programme.desc: 看看那些突破物理,化學和工程極限的動物,牠們實現人類夢想中的能力,並找出進化如何賦予牠們如此驚人的能力有時生存只能依靠超能力

programme.title: 動物超感官 第一季 #3 英普
programme.desc: 潛入人類感知以外令人眼花繚亂的世界,動物利用牠們的超感官來感測我們看不到的光,聽不到的聲音,甚至是我們無法察覺的陌生力量

programme.title: 動物解碼 #1 英普
programme.desc: 從超遠距離的鯨歌,到大象的亞聲,再至墨魚皮膚上閃爍的訊息,動物們有著令人難以置信的調情,戰鬥,聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套動物語言等待我們解碼

programme.title: 動物解碼 #2 英普
programme.desc: 從超遠距離的鯨歌,到大象的亞聲,再至墨魚皮膚上閃爍的訊息,動物們有著令人難以置信的調情,戰鬥,聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套動物語言等待我們解碼

programme.title: 動物解碼 #3 英普
programme.desc: 從超遠距離的鯨歌,到大象的亞聲,再至墨魚皮膚上閃爍的訊息,動物們有著令人難以置信的調情,戰鬥,聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套動物語言等待我們解碼

programme.title: 野生動物明星 #1 英普
programme.desc: 每一天在非洲都上演為生存而掙扎的戲碼捕獵者狂歡,而大自然的拾屍者亦在等待牠們的機會當強者死亡時,一支軍隊來吞噬別人留下的東西,因為牠們也必須養育寶貴的家庭

programme.title: 野生動物明星 #2 英普
programme.desc: 牠們的祖先是第一批在乾旱地區殖民的脊椎動物,除南極洲以外,牠們居住在每一個大陸,但牠們的世界正在迅速變化20個物種稱這個城市為家,但過去的濕地成了遊樂場,高爾夫球場和賽道這是牠們堅守的土地世界各地的青蛙數量正在下降,而且時間所剩無幾

programme.title: 野生動物明星 #3 英普
programme.desc: 在大陸上曾經多不勝數的大象,由於在過去的200年裡,因象牙和肉類而被濫捕,令數量急劇減少然而,南非的阿多大象國家公園和坦比大象公園等大象保護區給予了這些溫和的巨人們一點希望,牠們在公園內被保護,免受偷獵者滋擾,令數量正在回升

programme.title: 野生動物明星 #4 英普
programme.desc: 在非洲大草原上生存需要機智和奸狡,特別是兩名獵人:非洲野狗和侏獴這兩種神秘的物種都是群居,並依靠良好協調的團隊合作來取得成功從照顧初生之犢到尋找食物和抵禦敵人牠們都依靠緊密的家庭來克服日常的挑戰

programme.title: 野生動物明星 #5 英普
programme.desc: 一個複雜的關係網絡統治著地球上的所有生命 - 所有物種都相互聯繫,沒有一個能獨善其身某些關係是單向的,但其他則是互利的從鬆散的協力到緊密的伙伴關係,一切盡在大自然的偉大計劃之中物種之間複雜的互動關係甚至不僅限於動物 - 一些最好的例子發生在非洲茂密的山林中

programme.title: 啄木鳥:樹洞故事
programme.desc: 伴隨著一個獨特的鳥類家族的穩定鼓點行進了解為何世界上從大到小的239種啄木鳥都是自然界最好的伐木工;探索牠們的飛行,攀爬和呼叫技能;進入牠們的秘密巢穴一探究竟

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​觀看初學者第一次躍入空中的瞬間,就像一隻安地斯神鷹必須先去飛行學校接受訓練,然後才有可能展開雙翼翱翔遇見那些沒有羽毛卻能高飛的奇特傢伙,並驚嘆遊隼高速俯衝捕捉獵物的驚人速度,也讚嘆牠下墜時抓取獵物的猛烈迅捷

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在半空中善於抓獵的飛行者一起出獵,觀看敏捷的帝王蜻蜓完成蛻變的過程,欣賞倉鴞悄然無聲靠近獵物的潛行方式,並捕捉一隻流浪的蠑螈縱身一躍跳入深淵的驚險飛躍

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在空中交配遊戲中勝出的動物碰面,與一隻正調製專屬的愛情藥水蜜蜂一起起飛觀看一隻飛蜥為了抵禦對手而展翼滑翔,並見證一對日本丹頂鶴透過優雅的雙人舞姿締結一生的羈絆

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #4
programme.desc: 看動物穿越天空展開非凡的旅程穿梭在木製迷宮中的迅捷蒼鷹,加入沙雞艱辛遠行到遙遠水源的跋涉,並觀賞一群椋鳥形成的壯觀集體盤旋,迷惑牠們的天敵

programme.title: 13小時生還記 #1 英普
programme.desc: 深入潮池世界,旁觀寄居蟹四處覓屋,小貓鯊遇見奇怪的鄰居,並見證章魚化身獵食者,令獵物聞風喪膽在灼熱的日光下,池中氧氣逐漸耗盡,海鷗也看準時機,在水面上大快朵頤

programme.title: 13小時生還記 #2 英普
programme.desc: 夕陽西下,掠食者在潮池邊伺機行動,只待潮水再度湧來夜幕低垂,一隻愛偷竊的海蛞蝓與懂得翻騰兩周半的扇貝奮力求生;一對狡猾的螃蟹則挺而走險,展開一場充滿挑戰的求愛任務

programme.desc: 腔棘魚通常被稱為恐龍魚,在化石記錄中佔有獨特的地位,近一個世紀前重新發現它時震驚了科學界我們跟隨它的旅程直到今天,陪同 WildOceans 的科學家進行探險,以揭開它們更多的秘密和行為

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #3
programme.desc: 在《兩條鯊魚的故事》中,我們將看看南非海岸發現的各種各樣的鯊魚,重點關注瀕臨滅絕的路氏雙髻鯊和標誌性的大白鯊

programme.title: 野外的一年:羅莽湖 #1
programme.desc: 春天來了,遷徙的魚鷹重返公園懷孕的歐洲馬鹿下山到低地產子兩隻大公雞在山腰為了爭奪交配權,而展開一場名為力的奇觀

programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners Their large size is one of their features Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets

programme.title: I Can't Breathe
programme.desc: Police brutality against marginalised communities is not isolated to American shores In 2015, David Dungay Jr, an Aboriginal Australian, died in police custody The coroner later found a “lack of oxygen while he was restrained as a contributing factor to his death”, drawing disturbing parallels with the death of George Floyd in May this year Stan Grant, himself of Aboriginal heritage, feels a kinship across the continents “When I see black America, I see part of myself When I was growing up black America spoke to me when white Australia did not” For those who believe race is no longer an issue that needs discussion, he has a simple message “Why do we still talk about racism? Because it still exists Because it is there Because it can touch my life at any time”

programme.title: Inside Maximum Security
programme.desc: 5 hardened criminals, 1 unique prison, in a ground-breaking observational documentary series, that will show you for the first time what prison is really like Changi Prison is a concret purgatory, spartan to the extreme There are no beds, no pillows and no chairs in the cells A shower is done stooping above a toilet hole Humiliating strip searches are routine, as a matter of security Yet, practiced in this prison are some of the most sophisticated methods to reform the hearts and minds of the most reclacitrant prisoners So much so that Singapore's reoffending rates are among the lowest globally Yet even at those low rates, at least 1-in-5 inmates are back in jail within 2 years after their release For the first time ever, six inmates, incarcerated multiple times, agree to reveal their full udentities, for our cameras to capture their lives behind bars, as they unfold Will the regime in jail finally be enough for them to renounce a life of crime? Will this be their final stint in Changi Prison?

programme.title: Inside Maximum Security
programme.desc: 5 hardened criminals, 1 unique prison, in a ground-breaking observational documentary series, that will show you for the first time what prison is really like Changi Prison is a concret purgatory, spartan to the extreme There are no beds, no pillows and no chairs in the cells A shower is done stooping above a toilet hole Humiliating strip searches are routine, as a matter of security Yet, practiced in this prison are some of the most sophisticated methods to reform the hearts and minds of the most reclacitrant prisoners So much so that Singapore's reoffending rates are among the lowest globally Yet even at those low rates, at least 1-in-5 inmates are back in jail within 2 years after their release For the first time ever, six inmates, incarcerated multiple times, agree to reveal their full udentities, for our cameras to capture their lives behind bars, as they unfold Will the regime in jail finally be enough for them to renounce a life of crime? Will this be their final stint in Changi Prison?

programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康強盛的教會? 改變社區可以轉化城市? 作為基督徒,我們又如何盡忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一個「幸福小組」,讓教會續步履行三個使命!由台灣高雄福氣教會牧者主講,從《聖經》的話語開始,一起來學習「幸福」智慧!

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷

programme.title: 主日講壇-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:作個真理的「吹哨人」 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 今日説法
programme.desc: 《今日說法》是一檔日播法治欄目,秉持“點滴記錄中國法治進程的理念,以“重在普法,監督執法,促進立法、服務百姓為宗旨,採用“以案說法、大眾參與、專家點評的節目樣式進行普法宣傳,被譽“中國人的法制午餐。節目前半部分呈現記者深入基層採訪的真實案例,後半部分由演播室中的主持人和嘉賓對節目進行點評,體現節目品質和社會價值。

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 康有為、梁啟超提出戊戌變法，要學生讀通識，農夫學耕田？慈禧請來義和團對付八國聯軍，最終被火燒圓明園，王晶、游清源計算她一生的成與敗。古代靈異事件研究所所長翻查古書，借助現代高科技揭開古代靈異事件之謎！

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 中國古代有四大美人，黎芷珊訪問羞花美人楊貴妃。當年已為人妻的她為何會被老爺搶去？被唐玄宗趕出宮後，她如何憑一頭秀髮重返宮中？人稱關二哥的關羽為何得到黑白二道崇拜？綠帽、紅面、大關刀的形象又由誰人設計？

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 「巨聲幫」林欣彤、陳慧敏決戰「兄弟幫」范振鋒、林盛斌。在波爾多，馬球有新玩法，猜猜會以甚麼取代馬匹？Do姐大方讓眾人提問，卻被阿范氣得呼其「鋒哥」，究竟發生何事？鄺潔楹帶大家參觀東京特色酒店，房內的蛋形物件大有用途！去旅行，當然要認識當地文化，法國人喝酒時有指定動作，關乎會否「行衰運」！兩位兄弟在答題板以「Jump」代「斟」，搞乜東東？兌換環節，慧敏賽前曾得方力申提供「貼士」，可會信錯人？

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 黃翠如與陸浩明（6號）接受Do姐的問題大考驗，6號於看片前還拿「肥媽」來創作口號，現場反應卻不似預期。韓國的濟州盛產綠茶，在火山爆發形成的洞穴咖啡店內，還有特別的綠茶體驗？曼谷的非一般停車位，有何條件方能使用？周星馳的電影告訴大家，不可單憑外表判斷物品的用途。「問題專員」鄺潔楹在東京找來幾可亂真的「煙肉露筍卷」，其「真身」是……有嘉賓的二千積分最終價值不足一港元，到底兌換期間發生了甚麼事？

programme.title: 文明啟航粵英
programme.desc: Bettany繼續她的旅程,走訪烏茲別克、喬治亞、亞塞拜然、希臘、土耳其和保加利亞等地探索偏遠的社區,為觀眾帶來新的考古發掘以及意想不到的故事。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 為炒熱星夢公主杯的氣氛，星輝集團點名Meltic StAr加入戰團，但她們近來的表現令露露娜感到不滿，於是露露娜邀請了一位嘉賓，她就是白米飯區的偶像激川結衣。Meltic StAr在莫名奇妙下被逼幫忙種植稻米，情況變得狼狽得很…

programme.title: 喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險粵普
programme.desc: 未來的小羊們獲得了灰太狼新制的發明“變小手錶”，變成迷你版小羊並坐上慢羊羊發明的玩具小車，前往微觀世界，幫助大家解決各式各樣的問題。

programme.title: 喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險粵普
programme.desc: 未來的小羊們獲得了灰太狼新制的發明“變小手錶”，變成迷你版小羊並坐上慢羊羊發明的玩具小車，前往微觀世界，幫助大家解決各式各樣的問題。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 網上流行拍攝奇蹟影片，大雄等人欲仿傚但不成功，多啦A夢借他「奇蹟鏡頭」，鏡頭下一切變成奇蹟。「開心扭蛋機」讓人以身上任何物品換取機會，眼見其他人都抽到好東西，大雄和多啦A夢欲罷不能。

programme.title: LET'S CAMP! 露營少女粵日
programme.desc: 撫子、凜和綾乃三人吃過早餐後，便出發去寸又峽看夢之吊橋，並在足湯咖啡店重遇阿布特式火車上的兩位大姊姊。臨別依依，綾乃不願回家，三人於是延遲解散，去走全世界最長的木橋蓬萊橋。

programme.title: 嫁到這世界邊端粵
programme.desc: 香港OL Judy一次到泰國旅遊，改寫了一生。Judy說出七年前與Dass在翟道翟初次邂逅的故事，陳貝兒點出了不合理的情節，力證Judy那一刻已採取極主動攻勢！其後Judy以慶祝生日作藉口，特意飛往泰國，溶化了Dass的心。兩人言語不通，是怎樣打破彼此隔膜，深入了解對方的內心？嫁到泰國，Judy與Dass一同發展其精品店，承受炎熱天氣及骯髒環境，Judy為摯愛甘願捱苦，令貝兒感覺到兩口子的幸福。

programme.title: 教煮爭霸粵
programme.desc: 鼎爺手起刀落示範斬雞，斬得俐落還要砌得好睇；三姐則教路燉出滴雞精。俊彥以紅酒入饌炮製「紅酒燉雞」。除了西菜必備的洋蔥、西芹、甘筍，菜式還加入煎香意大利醃豬腩肉的香味。期間鼎爺突然考俊彥對烹調的認知，幸俊彥經驗搭夠過關！煒哥帶來創新「海南雞壽司」，以椰香飯配上嫩滑雞肉，煒哥即席示範浸雞技巧。她以斑蘭葉、紅尖椒等炮製兩款醬汁，一啖一口的海南雞飯帶來視覺、味覺新享受。今集是法國菜式與南亞風味的「角力」！

programme.title: 教煮爭霸粵
programme.desc: 今集以麵食為主題，鼎爺示範手搓銀針粉，三姐則傳授令紅薯粉口感QQ的技巧。煒哥即席製作薄薄的麵皮裹着五香豆腐、蝦皮、粉絲、韭菜餡料，煎得金黃香脆，幻化成特色北方美食「韭菜盒子」，配上清涼的「韓式番茄仔」同吃，開胃減膩！俊彥以全雞、金華火腿製作雞濃湯配上手工麵，將煎香雞丸串懸在碗邊，既能保持香脆的口感，又令菜式賣相精緻獨特。煒哥與俊彥都以手作麵為亮點，盡顯心思及耐性，誰的作品能令評判眼前一亮？

programme.title: 世紀工程︰機場三跑道系統粵
初入職場·中醫季粵普
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵

programme.title: 一周星星直播粵

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 張與辰到訪上環一間娘惹私房餐廳，品嚐其喜愛的香料魚肉蒸蛋，並在老闆指導下親自炮製這道菜。中韓混血兒李明憲帶伍倩彤到本地首間韓式中華料理餐廳，品嚐韓式炸醬麵與糖醋肉，二人更因不同吃法而起爭執。伍倩彤再隨深水埗地膽昌哥到區內「人氣」麵店品嚐車仔麵，花膠、柚皮、墨魚角及豬油渣等特色配料不容錯過。黃嘉雯則帶胡美貽到全港首間日式手卷吧，試食即叫即製的赤身、紅蝦、椰子蝦及避風塘軟殼蟹手卷，各具特色風味。

programme.desc: 香港OL Judy一次到泰國旅遊，改寫了一生。Judy說出七年前與Dass在翟道翟初次邂逅的故事，陳貝兒點出了不合理的情節，力證Judy那一刻已採取極主動攻勢！其後Judy以慶祝生日作藉口，特意飛往泰國，溶化了Dass的心。兩人言語不通，是怎樣打破彼此隔膜，深入了解對方的內心？嫁到泰國，Judy與Dass一同發展其精品店，承受炎熱天氣及骯髒環境，Judy為摯愛甘願捱苦，令貝兒感覺到兩口子的幸福。

programme.desc: 鼎爺手起刀落示範斬雞，斬得俐落還要砌得好睇；三姐則教路燉出滴雞精。俊彥以紅酒入饌炮製「紅酒燉雞」。除了西菜必備的洋蔥、西芹、甘筍，菜式還加入煎香意大利醃豬腩肉的香味。期間鼎爺突然考俊彥對烹調的認知，幸俊彥經驗搭夠過關！煒哥帶來創新「海南雞壽司」，以椰香飯配上嫩滑雞肉，煒哥即席示範浸雞技巧。她以斑蘭葉、紅尖椒等炮製兩款醬汁，一啖一口的海南雞飯帶來視覺、味覺新享受。今集是法國菜式與南亞風味的「角力」！

programme.title: 教煮爭霸粵
programme.desc: 今集以麵食為主題，鼎爺示範手搓銀針粉，三姐則傳授令紅薯粉口感QQ的技巧。煒哥即席製作薄薄的麵皮裹着五香豆腐、蝦皮、粉絲、韭菜餡料，煎得金黃香脆，幻化成特色北方美食「韭菜盒子」，配上清涼的「韓式番茄仔」同吃，開胃減膩！俊彥以全雞、金華火腿製作雞濃湯配上手工麵，將煎香雞丸串懸在碗邊，既能保持香脆的口感，又令菜式賣相精緻獨特。煒哥與俊彥都以手作麵為亮點，盡顯心思及耐性，誰的作品能令評判眼前一亮？

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 骨質疏鬆症是一種骨骼新陳代謝的病症，常見於長者，而女性一般在停經後會停止分泌雌激素，因此較男性更容易出現骨質疏鬆的情況。患者因為骨質密度減少，令骨骼結構變得脆弱，因而容易導致骨折、造成痛楚，以及引發其他併發症。值得留意的是，骨質疏鬆並非只是一個「老人病」，年輕女性若長期節食、曬太陽不足以及有家族史，都可能提早出現骨質疏鬆症。

programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
再創世紀#35粵PG
programme.desc: 天生故意讓明晞看到澤雨的死訊，但明晞反應冷淡。定垚聽着澤雨的遺言感悲痛，認定是天生派人殺死他。高哲查出天生會將烏托邦計劃賣給彼列後沽空，定垚擔心泡沫爆破會拖垮整個金融體系，說服程凱用超級電池救亡。可惜此舉未能阻止大市跌勢，突然有一神秘資金大手接貨。天生因沽空失利，大發雷霆，明晞意外發現天生藏起來的藥。內幕交易一案天生成功脫罪，隨即計劃啟動新一輪金融泡沫，定垚不忿，誓要找出天生的罪證！

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 夏秋交替之際，若想利用鮮花為家居增添一份秋日氣息，如何挑選？花道專家到來分享選花心得，還即場示範製作精緻的「鮮花風鈴」。風鈴隨風擺動，為家中更添浪漫秋意。這次「跟大廚去搵食」，李偉強師傅帶領大王、菲比一同探索正宗韓式滋味。店內的韓式炸雞款式豐富，醬油與蒜香等經典口味一應俱全，還有「醬豬蹄」、「水冷麵」、「八爪魚煎餅」等，都是地道的韓國美食。「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐帶來「皺皮椒菜脯炒腩片」。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵
programme.desc: 吃貨們要試澳門葡式口味，竟錯往珠海橫琴？原來是價錢作怪！豬扒包、焗豬扒飯與咖喱牛腩飯等澳葡美食、各有滋味秘訣。深圳潮汕菜食店內，食材船盛載多種即日海鮮讓顧客自選，每道菜式配以不同醬汁，為水產再提鮮！主持亦有隱世茶室推介，放鬆寫意度過下午。留港覓食，繼續有驚喜優惠。以花為主題的火鍋套餐，牛肉、特飲賣相精緻，額外加購七色丸子及餃子，更添口腹滿足感！另外，粥麵點心餐廳提供本地情懷套餐，人均不需百元。

programme.title: 天梯#6粵
programme.desc: 世雯出嫁時，新月懷疑丈夫不忠而忘記帶思行找世雯，幸得苗天協助讓世雯摸了牙縫。世章定讓世豪出任大查櫃，遭坤堯反對。新月發現愛娣住處，逼愛娣即時離開廣州。世章胸口劇痛送院，愛娣向新月道出自己與世章的關係。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#175粵
programme.desc: 溢與義欲到日本旅行，二人拆利是時，義發現每年家人在利是上「厚此薄彼」。溢向家人提起日本之行，眾長輩集資助他。義提出欲同行卻遭反對，一怒之下連飯也不吃，立即回房。義有感慶非常偏心，竟自暴自棄起來。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#20粵普PG
programme.desc: 裘千仞和楊康先後騙全真七子說黃藥師殺害周伯通和郭靖，梅超風不敵七子，歐陽鋒殺譚處端，梅超風護黃藥師而受傷…郭靖現身救與黃藥師對戰的江南六怪，黃藥師為他療傷後帶傻姑回桃花島，郭靖和黃蓉要去岳州找打狗棒。

programme.title: 我是小廚神-新加坡篇粵普
programme.desc: 4強賽分兩個回合進行，分別以「水果」和「海鮮」作主題，出線的兩位小朋友會晉級總決賽。Tebo在水果戰表現失準，收拾心情後能否重拾信心？Leonika從容不迫、享受煮食過程的態度令評判另眼相看！鬼馬的Joshua喜擺甫士，奉上的精緻甜品「蘋果酥鬆餅」，能否俘虜女評判的心？Onaya遵從家傳食譜做出的海鮮米粉，味道如何？最終哪兩位獲評判張倩敏、楊國基和陳凱琳青睞，進入總決賽？

programme.title: CI ALK 國際直球對決(重)

programme.desc: 全新場景、全新比賽陣容、全新遊戲並結合世界各國的場景與關卡。考驗麻吉好友和團體的合作默契，一場場歡笑、緊張與刺激的團體競賽，陪伴大朋友小朋友週末的歡聚時光。

programme.title: 異想天開木瓜島
programme.desc: 歡迎來到木瓜島！這是一個與世隔絕的地方，有著獨特又古怪的傳統，木瓜島的每個孩子都有小牛看護者，除了一個不知怎麼來到島上的孩子－－卡庫佩，經過種種努力，終於得到一隻神經質的小牛蘇格拉底。而這對特別的搭檔，將會挑戰木瓜島的傳統……

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎
programme.desc: 【姜素拉化身訴訟女神離婚怨偶再擦出火花】所謂「相愛容易，相處難」，恩範&荷拉已愛情長跑10年、結婚3年，因男方外遇出軌導致離婚收場。專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉，時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗、前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題，對她來說前夫只是「行走的贍養費」。原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司被客戶追著跑，窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表，簽下聘用合約。面對「最熟悉的陌生人」前夫恩範，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 殘酷的實習生
programme.desc: 【羅美蘭化身高年級實習生道盡女性職場家庭壓力】曾叱吒職場的女強人高海羅，在為家庭中斷事業七年後，決心重返職場、找回自我價，從主管跌回實習生，她不僅要面對年齡與職場現實的殘酷挑戰，更得直面昔日競爭對手、如今成為上司的崔智媛。在一項充滿道德兩難的任務中，海羅被迫於同為母親的立場與職涯機會之間掙扎。劇情深刻刻畫中年女性在家庭、工作與自我之間的拉扯與重生，以真實而細膩的情感，引發無數職場女性共鳴。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 不像三兄弟(完)
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 陷入純情(完)
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: 青春時代(完)
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，寫下青春紀事！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，個性、人生目標和對男人的品味皆不相同。會有意見不合、吵架的時候，但隨著時間相處，築起溫暖的友情、像家人一樣的相處。同住一個屋簷下，寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: 青春時代(完)
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，寫下青春紀事！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，個性、人生目標和對男人的品味皆不相同。會有意見不合、吵架的時候，但隨著時間相處，築起溫暖的友情、像家人一樣的相處。同住一個屋簷下，寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 青春時代2
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 韶華若錦(完)
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎
programme.desc: 【姜素拉化身訴訟女神離婚怨偶再擦出火花】所謂「相愛容易，相處難」，恩範&荷拉已愛情長跑10年、結婚3年，因男方外遇出軌導致離婚收場。專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉，時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗、前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題，對她來說前夫只是「行走的贍養費」。原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司被客戶追著跑，窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表，簽下聘用合約。面對「最熟悉的陌生人」前夫恩範，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 殘酷的實習生
programme.desc: 【羅美蘭化身高年級實習生道盡女性職場家庭壓力】曾叱吒職場的女強人高海羅，在為家庭中斷事業七年後，決心重返職場、找回自我價，從主管跌回實習生，她不僅要面對年齡與職場現實的殘酷挑戰，更得直面昔日競爭對手、如今成為上司的崔智媛。在一項充滿道德兩難的任務中，海羅被迫於同為母親的立場與職涯機會之間掙扎。劇情深刻刻畫中年女性在家庭、工作與自我之間的拉扯與重生，以真實而細膩的情感，引發無數職場女性共鳴。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: 青春時代2
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 青春時代2
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - El castillo de Robins
programme.desc: Como la lente no se puede recuperar, el Dr. No quiere fabricar otra, pero necesita petirrojos para ello. Así que ataca Rubidia, una región repleta de piedras preciosas. Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La trampa de la armonica
programme.desc: Chip y sus amigos crean una zona con formaciones que se asemejan a instrumentos musicales y armonizan sus sonidos. De repente, quedan atrapados en un rectángulo de cristales de cuarzo que vibran al formar una trampa sónica. Un átomo músico, que los ha capturado, busca miembros para formar una orquesta. Los antimateriales están cerca y Chip le pide al músico que prepare la trampa para retenerlos y escapar. El músico acepta y los antimateriales se convierten en prisioneros, obligándolos a escuchar el terrible sonido de sus composiciones.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is a curious little robot who loves making friends, discovering new things, and having fun with music, magic, animals, and more. Every day is a new adventure for Rookie—whether he’s chasing a bouncing ball, exploring the stars, or learning how something works. He’s always ready to laugh, try again when things get tricky, and share big smiles with the friends he meets along the way. With Rookie, even the smallest moments become exciting discoveries!

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - Sabotaje
programme.desc: Chip es un niño de 9 años que prefiere jugar con sus compañeros antes de las clases de física y química con su maestra Susan. Un día, durante una visita escolar al Instituto de Alta Energía, un científico loco, el Dr. No, está realizando un experimento con una lente capaz de convertir materia en antimateria, lo que provoca un accidente y un rayo incontrolado que lanza a Chip y al científico a la dimensión del micromundo. Chip se da cuenta de que el accidente lo ha enviado a un lugar desconocido y no sabe cómo regresar. Unos átomos de hierro, mercurio e hidrógeno, representados como Fer, Merc e Hidro, lo guiarán para ayudarlo a encontrar el camino de vuelta. Al mismo tiempo, el Dr. No descubre que, debido al accidente, ha logrado crear antimateria, y el poder que esto le otorga lo prepara para convertirse en el amo del mundo.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La corriente electrica
programme.desc: Fer, Merc e Hidro llevan a Chip a la Ciudad Atómica, donde hay noticias de otro humano, el Dr. No, que ha llegado al micromundo. Chip piensa que tal vez el Dr. No podría ayudarlo a regresar a su dimensión, y va a verlo para devolverle la lente que el científico perdió durante el viaje al micromundo. Pero el Dr. No está construyendo la Torre Negra, una poderosa máquina que lo ayudará a esclavizar a todos los átomos del micromundo. Ahora tiene muchos trabajando bajo sus órdenes, y los lanza contra Chip y sus amigos para convertirlos en prisioneros y arrebatarles la lente. Al escapar, Chip cae en una corriente eléctrica que lo transporta muy lejos.

programme.title: I Have Electric Dreams
programme.desc: 16-year-old Eva is experiencing her sexual awakening and is desperate to leave the house she shares with her mother and younger sister and move in with her estranged father, a troubled artist who paints, sculpts, writes poetry and drinks too much.

programme.title: Helen Dorn: After The Storm
programme.desc: After a celebration in her rural hometown, Karla Petersen is murdered on her way home. Inspector Helen Dorn takes on the case but clashes with local officer Tom Petersen, Karla's brother, who defies warnings to find his sister's killer.

programme.title: Kamikaze
programme.desc: A suicide bomber gets stuck in a hotel with his intended victims when their flight is cancelled because of a snow storm. Over the next few days, he befriends them and even falls in love. Can he finish his deadly mission when they board the plane again?

programme.title: Lost In Marseille
programme.desc: Bruno, a stay-at-home father of two, gets back in touch with his masculinity when his wife is kidnapped in Marseille. Instead of the planned holiday on the Côte d'Azur, Bruno gets deeper and deeper into an intrigue, pursued by police and mafia.

programme.title: Kingdom S01 - EP6

programme.title: Great Asian Railway Journeys S01 - Hong Kong
programme.desc: Michael begins his adventures in Hong Kong, with railway highlights including the cable funicular to the top of Hong Kong's highest mountain, the Peak, and the enviable Mass Transit System.

programme.title: Great Asian Railway Journeys S01 - Jakarta to Borobudur
programme.desc: In the heaving megacity of Jakarta, Michael Portillo uncovers Indonesia's colonial past as part of a Dutch empire and its rich history as a port.

programme.desc: Beginning in Java's royal city, Yogyakarta, Michael Portillo visits the Sultan's Palace and witnesses the ancient art of shadow puppetry, known as wayang.

programme.title: Great Asian Railway Journeys S01 - Penang to Cameron Highlands

programme.title: Great Asian Railway Journeys S01 - Kuala Lumpur to Johor Bahru
programme.desc: In Kuala Lumpur, Michael tries the ancient art of pewter smithing and learns how the discovery of tin transformed a muddy estuary into Malaysia's thriving capital.

programme.title: Great Asian Railway Journeys S01 - Singapore

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls S01 - Deion Sanders
programme.desc: The retired footballer travels to the southern Utah desert after his kids accuse him of softness. They hike through the desert, but Deion's fear of snakes must soon be overcome.

programme.title: Walking With Dinosaurs S01 - The Pack
programme.desc: Seventy-one million years ago lived a teenage Albertosaurus - a faster, nimbler relative of T. rex. She had to earn her place in a deadly, ferocious pack or risk starvation. Today, palaeontologists in western Canada are unearthing her remains, allowing us to imagine her story. Based on real-world evidence, stunning VFX recreate her encounters, from hunting pterosaurs to fighting the dominant matriarch and battling for survival in the brutal late Cretaceous world.

programme.title: Uncharted Amazon with Ash Dykes S01 - To the Sea
programme.desc: Ash and the team begin their final push to the ocean, but the journey becomes a brutal test of endurance. Facing rapids, storms, exhaustion and injury, they battle on through remote wilderness. After setbacks - including a damaged kayak - they press on, paddling for 36 hours straight. On Day 37, they finally reach the Atlantic, completing an extraordinary world‑record expedition.

programme.desc: Paddy McGuinness and Cherry Healey visit a factory producing half a million sausage rolls a day.

programme.title: Walking With Dinosaurs S01 - The Pack
programme.desc: Seventy-one million years ago lived a teenage Albertosaurus - a faster, nimbler relative of T. rex. She had to earn her place in a deadly, ferocious pack or risk starvation. Today, palaeontologists in western Canada are unearthing her remains, allowing us to imagine her story. Based on real-world evidence, stunning VFX recreate her encounters, from hunting pterosaurs to fighting the dominant matriarch and battling for survival in the brutal late Cretaceous world.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Pet Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels meet a scruffelump in the woods, and despite Duggee's reservations, take him in. But they soon learn the responsibilities of taking care of a pet.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Golden Gate Bridge, USA
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch has stolen the Golden Gate Bridge fog horns, meaning trouble! Can the Go Jetters save the large cargo ship from crashing into the bridge?

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - Giant's Causeway, Northern Ireland
programme.desc: A Giant Grandmaster Glitch means BIG trouble for the Giant's Causeway - can the Go Jetters stop him in his tracks?

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Deep Trouble
programme.desc: Max and Monty's antics on a construction site get them into trouble when they ignore the danger warning signs.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S02 - Bubble Bumbling
programme.desc: The Bubble Man is in town so a visit to the Big Shop is in order for Sarah, Duck and Donkey.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S02 - Toggle Tangle
programme.desc: After Sarah helps Scarf Lady prepare the wool for her new roof, she settles down for a dreamy sleep.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Detective
programme.desc: Myrtle calls Stanley to help solve the mystery of the Phantom Knitter. Overhearing this, Fifi jumps at the chance to help forming a dynamic, detective duo!

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - First Aid
programme.desc: Myrtle calls Stanley to see if she can practice her first aid skills on him, but he's all fit and healthy. Instead, they go about the town making good use of Myrtle's newfound abilities.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - No Kissing In School
programme.desc: From feeling nervous and shy, to making a million friends! The funny animals chat about all the things they love about school.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S03 - It's Time for a Harvest Festival
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran join Julie at the farm for the harvest festival. Julie gives JoJo, Gran Gran and their friends a special tractor ride to the harvesting field, where there's lots for everyone to do. JoJo loves helping out with Alfie, Isaiah and Henry. But what can they do with all the fruit - it's time for a Gran Gran plan?

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Show and Tell
programme.desc: Bluey wants to know why Dad's always bossing her around.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Dragon
programme.desc: When Bluey needs some assistance drawing a dragon for a story she is working on, she asks her dad, Bandit, for help.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Wild Girls
programme.desc: Coco wants to play Wild Girls with Indy, but Chloe wants her to play another game.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Imagination Badge
programme.desc: When the Squirrels tell Duggee that they have nothing left to play with, he encourages them to use their imagination.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Recipe Badge
programme.desc: The hungry Squirrels turn to Duggee when they aren't sure what to eat. Fortunately, he has his cookbook The Clubhouse Kitchen: Tasty Bites for Hungry Squirrels.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Eugene's Animal Chorus
programme.desc: Eugene gives an unexpected performance with help from some talented animals! Mooo!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Go Jet Academy: Artificial Reef
programme.desc: Kyan, Lars and Foz pick up litter on the Academy beach after a storm, while Xuli dives down to check the coral reef. She spots something in the murky depths: a huge rusty submarine lies across the reef, and the moustache on the bow means it must belong to Grandmaster Glitch. What's worse, it's leaking oil!

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Artichoke
programme.desc: Little artichoke sings about being the rhyming queen.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Brussels Sprout
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's tiny Brussels Sprout performing I'm Mighty and proving how great he is.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Walkie Talkie
programme.desc: The veggies are playing walkie-talkie hide-and-seek, but Evil Pea steals Carrot's walkie-talkie and uses it to trick the Veggies into getting trapped by the Corn Cobs.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Evil Pea's Party Plan
programme.desc: It's Evil Pea's birthday, but she and Carrot are trapped in the bottom of her freezer. They must put their differences aside and work together to escape.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Say Hello
programme.desc: Tinky Winky and Laa-­Laa are in Home Dome when the Tubby Phone rings. It's Dipsy and Po calling from the Tubby Mobile to say 'Hello'.

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of "Robin Hood" meets "The Sting". Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying (who's done over 400 films) as Tricky Ching, it's the age-old competition between a rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man. It's a game Chen cannot afford to lose, because people's lives - including his own, hang in the balance of good versus evil.

programme.title: The Avenging Eagle
programme.desc: Qi Ming Xing, an assassin of the Iron Boat Clan, decides to quit the clan. When hunted by the clan, he is saved by Swordsman Zhuo Yi Fan. Zhuo accidentally discovers that Qi is the killer of his wife, but forgives him after knowing Qi's guilt over her death. The two finally team up to destroy the evil clan.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: Woman of the Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: Lady With A Sword
programme.desc: Swordswoman Feng tries to find a group of villains responsible for her eldest sister's death, but is shocked to discover that her fiancé, Jin, is one of them. At the same time, Jin's mother and the two other killers are planning to kill Feng. Can Feng fight back and take her revenge?

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: The Enchantress
programme.desc: Shot on the Shaws' lot in the final years of Hong Kong's greatest studio, The Enchantress tells the story of martial artists who disappear in the night! Intrigued, wanna-be detectiveswordsman Feng Chi-wu (Mok Siu-chung) is determined to find out what is happening. But when Feng finds out that an evil vampire spirit (Wei Chiu-hua) is killing swordsmen, he's in for more than he bargains for... It's an outlandish fairy-tale and martial arts fantasy, where your fists and sword aren't nearly enough!

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen's brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wen's home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the all-new one-armed hero - a swordsman who chops off his right arm rather than live with dishonour. When the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend is murdered by the evil gang, it is time to battle.

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: After years in prison, Lu Hu returns home to find himself set up by his ruthless brother Piao, who has taken over the family coal mine business and imprisoned their sister. Hu takes down Piao and saves his sister but their coal mine falls into the hands of a Japanese gang, which Hu and his sister must fight in order to get it back.

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: Filmmaker Wong Jing produced Mercenaries From Hong Kong, his very first modern-day adventure drama. In the dramatic plot he wrote, he sends superstars Ti Lung, Chen Hui-min, Wang Lung-wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu on a deadly mission. The film's action sequences are all closely guided by three great kung fu choreographers, led by Tang Chia!

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: The Lizard
programme.desc: A seasoned burglar 'The Lizard' sets himself up against a corrupt police chief and announced that he will steal a diamond from a rich man's party. His real identity, which is discovered by the corrupt police chief's granddaughter, is actually a young policeman who is doing it all for justice.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father's towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: That Fiery Girl
programme.desc: The bandits of Hulu Valley slay the chief of the Mei Clan while searching for a treasure map. In retaliation, Chun from the Mei Clan infiltrates the bandit's fortress to map a way in for the authorities, but ends up falling in love with the bandit leader's daughter, Pearl. While Chun's plot is uncovered, he receives unexpected help from Pearl.

programme.title: That Fiery Girl
programme.desc: The bandits of Hulu Valley slay the chief of the Mei Clan while searching for a treasure map. In retaliation, Chun from the Mei Clan infiltrates the bandit's fortress to map a way in for the authorities, but ends up falling in love with the bandit leader's daughter, Pearl. While Chun's plot is uncovered, he receives unexpected help from Pearl.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other.

programme.title: Return of Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A band of ninjas slaughters the entire Wu Dang Clan and frames Du Gu Wu Di, chief of the Invincible Clan, for the deed. Yun masters the silkworm martial arts style and decides to take revenge for the Clan by challenging Wu Di, but is defeated and seriously hurt. Luckily, Master Li saves and treats him, allowing Yun to avoid the ninjas' pursuit.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense…

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain men's life essence. With a Taoist's help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: Disciples of the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: In the finale of this trilogy, Gordon Liu reprises his famous role, Monk San Te, as he tries to protect Fang Shih Yu, an arrogant youth who gets into trouble with the Qing officials, and nearly lands Shaolin Temple into trouble too.

programme.title: Men From The Gutter
programme.desc: Two very different cops are out to capture a local drug boss. In this sizzling crime thriller, the two cops go about doing their jobs differently - one does everything to the letter of the law and the other just doing whatever it takes to solve crime.

programme.title: The Emperor and his Brother
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later. As it happens, the chef of this organisation is Qianlong's younger brother and they must now confront each other in opposing roles…

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Holy Flame of the Martial World
programme.desc: Yin Tian Chou's parents were killed over a pair of flame-shaped blades. He and his sister were rescued, raised, and trained separately by a hero and a villain, each inheriting one of the blades. Sworn enemies at first, they eventually uncover their true identities and join forces to avenge their parents' deaths.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: Water Clan Chief is severely wounded by a samurai killer shortly before the annual duel at Tai Lake. He sends his brother Bao Yu on a long journey to find an antidote for him. On the way, Bao Yu encounters Little Princess and falls in love with her, not knowing that she is hiding a secret plot…

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people's livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The prince of the Sung Dynasty is captured by the Chin invaders and guarded by top martial arts masters. Two powerful patriots need to fight the overwhelming odds and pull off the impossible: to rescue the royal Prince and get out of the Chin stronghold alive.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: The Daredevils
programme.desc: Corrupt general Wang Li assumes power by killing his superior. The son of the murdered superior befriends four street performers called “The Venoms”, and they help him take revenge by posing as government officials offering a peace token to the corrupt general. When Wang arrives at a warehouse, he is ambushed by the Venoms!

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins.

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty
programme.desc: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hon's pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child. When she is hunted down herself, Rong hooks up with a former Flying Guillotine member and her martial arts senior to fight back...

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: One-armed Swordsman Fang Kang wants to lead a quiet life with his wife, but when she is abducted by the Eight Demon Swordsmen clan, he is forced to take them on in order to save her.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: Hong Kong rhapsody is a musical extravaganza full of song and dance! Peter Chen-Ho stars as a playboy magician who changes his ways after he becomes the guardian of a young singer (Li Ching), the daughter of a deceased magician friend.

programme.title: Five Superfighters
programme.desc: A kung fu master and his three students lost everything after they are floored by a bully. To take revenge, the students find ways to learn from other kung fu masters and come back six months later to have a rematch with the bully on their master's birthday.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the case in ten days and Zhan quickly sets off to investigate. Will they solve the case in time?

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: The Fastest Sword
programme.desc: Southern Swordsman Ting is named “The Fastest Sword” but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight challenges. Even so, he is forced to fight the Northern Swordsman. Who will win finally?

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: The Sword And The Lute
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his bride use the deadly weapon - Phoenix Lute to fight against evil, but the lute accidentally falls into the hands of bandits hoping to use it to take control of the province. Gui Wu must now fight to recover the lute and beat the bandits.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai…

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Hail the Judge
programme.desc: A low level magistrate is run out of town for defending a beautiful murder suspect. Through a series of comedic events he ascends to the top rank & returns looking for revenge.

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society’s conspiracy. A new drug is invented to boost bodies of the Japanese troops in war and the Chinese students are used in their experiments. Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its “Cop Shop Babes” as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat – can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter’s company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei’s possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to “Casino Tycoon”. 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down…

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Bandit Zhang Mu Zhi poses as a county chief and arrives in Goose Town hoping to make a fortune, only to encounter the ruthless and manipulative tycoon Huang Si Lang, who controls the town with fear and corruption. As the two powerful men clash, a thrilling battle of wits, deception, greed and gunfire erupts, throwing the entire town into chaos.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man’s father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes…

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team’s downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: Detective Lin forms a special task force to crack down on violent motorbike robbers terrorising Foshan and expose the syndicate behind them. However, when his pregnant wife becomes a victim during a brutal attack, Lin uncovers a ruthless conspiracy driven by revenge, pushing him into a dangerous battle against criminals with nothing to lose.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then…

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then…

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather’s fortune with one condition – he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang’s custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called “Kung Fu Stuntmen”. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian’s daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond…

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian and seek evidence against his gang. After their release, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, as Shan cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair…

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The legendary Stone Monkey gives hope to a desperate girl by promising to change her fate. Years later, after a fierce battle against the powerful three-eyed God of War, he is defeated and cast into the mortal world. Stripped of his former glory, Stone Monkey must rise again, confront powerful enemies, and fulfil the promise he once made.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi’s husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the world’s top stories as they happen. The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.title: Razor
programme.desc: CGTN's brand new science and technology show, covering cutting edge developments from all over the world. RAZOR will show you the world's most powerful laser and the world's smallest anti-cancer treatment. It will take you from the weird world of quantum computing to the boundaries of the cosmos. An international team of reporters will follow the guidance of Occam's Razor - the principle that the simplest explanation is the best one. RAZOR will show that we are already ""living in the future"!

programme.title: Africa Live
programme.desc: Africa Live is a news program that focuses on African issues and issues related to this diverse continent. CGTN’s Nairobi-based broadcast center produces Africa Live. Local correspondents and local production teams provide authoritative and in-depth stories from across the region. Africa Live is an objective and comprehensive look at every facet of African life.

programme.title: Faces of Africa
programme.desc: Faces of Africa is a topical magazine that showcases the diversity of the continent. Faces of Africa is about people. From intimate portraits of ordinary citizens to discussions with political, economic and civic leaders, Faces of Africa features compelling stories from an up close perspective.

programme.title: Talk Africa
programme.desc: Talk Africa is a weekly discussion show that brings the most influential voices in Africa to the world. Broadcast from CGTN’s production center in the Kenyan capital, Nairobi, Talk Africa looks at Africa and the world from an African perspective.

programme.title: Inheritors

Each 30-minute TV edition is hosted by a long-term expatriate in China who has a unique understanding of the country’s culture. He or she will introduce viewers to people who are dedicating their lives to its protection, inheritance, innovation, development and promotion.

programme.title: Travelogue
programme.desc: Travelogue is a 30-minute travel program. Through the journeys of our intrepid hosts, we experience the beauty, culture and mystery of China, discovering how people live in this vast country and showcasing China's transformation to the world.
